content.answer: At every ingestion boundary, compute now - ts and compare it against max_age: if now - ts <= max_age the record is still fresh and may be accepted; if now - ts > max_age (strictly older than max_age) the record is stale and must be rejected — and note that a non-empty payload proves presence, not freshness, so payload checks alone never authorize acceptance of a stale record.
content.reuse_advice: For any ingestion or validation boundary, always gate acceptance on an explicit freshness predicate (now - ts <= max_age, with the boundary defined and documented so a record exactly at max_age is fresh and anything strictly older is rejected), never treat payload presence or non-emptiness as evidence of freshness, and reject rather than silently accept when timestamp or reference time is missing.
